newsitem.title: UK: Lockheed in new Russian telecom JV-sources.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed in new Russian telecom JV-sources.

text.p: Lockheed Martin International, part of U.S. military and aerospace giant Lockheed Martin Corp, said on Friday it would announce a new global telecommunications joint venture on Monday in London.

The company provided no further details but industry sources told Reuters that Lockheed was likely to announce a joint venture with Russian firm Intersputnik, the former Soviet space agency which still owns several satellites inherited from the days of Cold War.
The sources said Lockheed is expected to hold a majority stake in the venture which would launch a series of satellites aimed at servicing the telecommunications and television industry.
The venture's headquarters is likely to be in London.
Financial details of the venture was not available.
